items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of influent screening and grit removal;
...biological removal of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and nitrogen in aerobic, anoxic, and pre-anoxic basins;
The treatment system consists of... microfiltration through a membrane bioreactor (MBR)...
Disinfection is achieved in an open channel UV disinfection system with sufficient low pressure/high output lamps to disinfect a peak daily flow of 4.0 mgd.
Waste activated sludge pumping removes excessive biomass from the system, followed by a proprietary sludge digestion process...
...dewatering via centrifuge, and disposal to a Class III solid waste landfill.
...and disposal to a Class III solid waste landfill.

The Facility includes a 5 million gallon aerated influent equalization basin and a 3.35 million gallon equalization basin, which provides equalization storage capacity for extended wet weather flows and plant return flows.
